name: Wireless Induction Speaker for Mobile Phones
description: Hamilton's Wireless Induction Speaker for Mobile Phones amplifies the sound from your handheld device without the mess and hassle of cords or searching for wifi. This completely portable ABS and rubber speaker requires no wires, wifi, configuration or pairing to use. Crisp, clear sound is delivered through the side speakers. Includes a USB cable and an aux audio cable. Hamilton's Wireless Induction Speaker for Mobile Phones comes backed by a one-year warranty. Key Features Completely portable Made of ABS plastic and rubber so it is highly durable Includes USB and aux audio cables Requires no wifi to use Backed by a one-year warranty Specifications Material: ABS and rubber Speaker: Double magnetic stereo speaker Battery Capacity: Three AA batteries (not included) Output Power: 2 watts x 2 Input Power: DC-5V Width: 4 3/4" Depth: 1 1/2" Height: 2 5/8"
